headword: よくある{質問|しつもん}

definitions.explanation: A section on websites, documents, or guides that compiles common questions and their answers. The Japanese equivalent of the English abbreviation FAQ.

examples.japanese: ⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧よくある{質問|しつもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
よくある{質問|しつもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っていた→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: The answer was on the FAQ page.

examples.japanese: お⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、よくある{質問|しつもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦いただければ→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧です。
examples.english: We would appreciate it if you could review the FAQ before making an inquiry.

notes:
USAGE:
The standard Japanese translation of FAQ. Found on nearly every Japanese website and product manual. The English abbreviation FAQ is also widely understood in Japan, though the Japanese phrase is more common on Japanese-language sites.

FORMS:
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ご⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧: polite form (with honorific prefix ご), common on corporate websites
- FAQ（エフエーキュー）: the English abbreviation, sometimes used alongside the Japanese phrase
